violations.text: Ice cream, and box of ice cream sandwiches/brownies were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
Establishment is lacking proper drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The outside dumpster area was observed with trash outside of dumpster. Establishment is to ensure that all trash is thrown away properly to prevent attracting pests. Refuse areas must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The wall in the walk-in cooler area was observed peeling and in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/20/2026

Small containers are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2025

The spout of the dipper well was observed below the flood rim of the well. This spout must have an air-gap. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025
